//: OPT-IN API lane via the bundled stdlib bridge (cli-bridge-openai) — no curl, no jq.
//1: Works with ANY OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek,
//2: Fireworks, a local vLLM/llama.cpp server, or your own gateway. Unlike the raw-curl
//3: recipe (byo-api-lane.json), the bridge PARSES the response and returns just the
//4: assistant text, so the council reads it like any other lane.
//5: SECRET-SAFE: the bridge reads the key from the env var NAMED in --key-env; the key
//6: VALUE is never put in argv (invisible in `ps`).
//7: OPT-IN: availability_env hides this lane until that env var is set, so adding the
//8: recipe never changes your surface until you export the key. (OpenRouter itself is
//9: built in as `ask_openrouter` — this is the template for OTHER providers.)
install_hint: export TOGETHER_API_KEY=...  (the bridge ships with cli-bridge — no extra install)
note: OpenAI-compatible API lane via the bundled bridge. Hidden until TOGETHER_API_KEY is set; the key is read from env by the bridge, never in argv. Swap base-url + key-env for any other provider.
